test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 16 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: VVPAT is a machine that is used in Indian elections to ensure that the citizen's vote has been correctly placed. What is the full form of VVPAT?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Voter Verifiable Paper Audit Trail**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **VVPAT** stands for **Voter Verifiable Paper Audit Trail**.
 
• It is a method of providing feedback to voters using a ballotless voting system.
 
• VVPAT is used in Indian elections to ensure that the citizen's vote has been correctly placed.
 
• The machine generates a paper slip with the name of the candidate for whom the vote was cast, allowing the voter to verify their vote.
 
• This paper slip is then deposited into a sealed box, which can be used later for cross-verification and auditing purposes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• VVPAT was first used in a by-election in Nagaland in 2013 and later in the general elections in 2014.
 
• The introduction of VVPAT has added an extra layer of transparency and trust in the electoral process.
 
• The system is intended to detect possible election fraud or malfunction and provide a means to audit the stored electronic results.
 
• VVPAT slips are counted in a randomly selected polling station in each Assembly constituency to cross-check the electronic results.
